title: Isolation of Nuclei from Paraffin-Embedded Tissue with Subsequent Immunostaining
author: Dorothe Moellmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.78phrvn

steps.title: Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Cut 60µm sections from paraffin material and add them to a 1.5ml tube.

steps.title: Dewax and Rehydrate
steps.instruction: Perform dewaxing and rehydration using a series of solvents at room temperature, removing and replacing each for 60 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in Xylene (99%) for 60:00:00
Incubate in 96% Ethanol for 60:00:00
Incubate in 70% Ethanol for 60:00:00

steps.title: Add Target Retrieval Solution
steps.instruction: After the final rehydration step, add 400 µL of Target Retrieval Solution pH9 (Dako Catalog #S2367).

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically homogenize the tissue until no large pieces remain.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2mm diameter stainless steel beads to the tube
Place tube in a homogenizer (e.g., Bullet Blender storm 24, NA-BB-15)
Homogenize at max speed for 02:00:00
Check result and repeat if necessary

steps.title: Heat Induced Epitope Retrieval (HIER)
steps.instruction: Perform HIER using a water bath and allow the sample to cool.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube in a preheated water bath at 98 °C for 60:00:00
Allow the tube to cool at room temperature for 30:00:00

steps.title: Wash Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove buffer and wash the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 5 min and discard the supernatant
Add 1x IHC-washing buffer (IHC-Waschpuffer)
Resuspend pellet by vortexing
Repeat centrifugation and supernatant removal

steps.title: Prepare Antibody Diluent Composite
steps.instruction: Prepare the antibody diluent composite consisting of Dako REAL Antibody Diluent (Dako Catalog #S2022), 0.5% Saponin (AppliChem Catalog #A4518.0100, CAS: 8047-15-2), and 2% BSA (Carl Roth Catalog #0163.2).

steps.title: Equilibrate Sample
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the pellet using the prepared antibody diluent composite.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
Add 400 µL of antibody diluent composite
Resuspend the pellet
Incubate at room temperature for 30:00:00

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample with the primary antibody at a concentration determined for each specific antibody.

substeps.instruction: Incubate overnight (16:00:00) at 4 °C
Maintain agitation using a rotator (e.g., Stuart Rotator SB3)

steps.title: Wash After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the sample to remove primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 5 min and discard the supernatant
Add IHC-washing buffer (IHC-Waschpuffer)
Repeat the wash once more

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample with the secondary antibody prepared in the antibody diluent composite at a predetermined concentration.

substeps.instruction: Mix the secondary antibody solution well
Incubate at room temperature for 60:00:00

steps.title: Final Wash and Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and return the sample to retrieval solution.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 5 min and discard supernatant
Centrifuge again at 5000 rpm for 5 min (e.g., using Eppendorf 5405000441)
Discard the supernatant
Add 400 µL of Target Retrieval Solution

steps.title: Storage and Microscopy
steps.instruction: Store the sample or proceed to imaging.

substeps.instruction: If necessary, store in Aqua dest at 4 °C
Perform fluorescence immunostaining for 3D reconstruction with a laser-scanning microscope (Leica TCS SP8)
If required, perform DAPI staining immediately before microscopy
